identifier: flash/T397 (also flash/T387 — same console, T387 closed under D054, fix claimed here per the Orchestrator's explicit offer)
notes: T397 — the u6 hang fix and the reading T387 was dispatched for. Full T387 measurement record (value curves, hypothesis, brackets, reach, scoring) lives in findings/T387-capture-budget.json and docs/research/capture-budget-2026-08-06.md.

hang.diagnosis: src/t387_budget.zig valueModeImpl: `var bitpos: u6 = 0; while (bitpos < 64) : (bitpos += 1)` — u6 holds 0..63, so the bound is a tautology; at 63 the += 1 wraps to 0 under -O ReleaseFast (Debug traps). Confirmed by the Orchestrator (D054): 2,554/2,554 stack samples at the two lines, 14h02m, 836 CPU-min, RSS 880 KB, no output. D054 and the T397 brief are the red evidence.
hang.fix: u7 counter (max 127 >= 64). The red-then-green test then caught a SECOND defect: Rank.dense/denseOf used a mask including the bit itself (mask = (1 << (low+1)) - 1), giving dense index = rank + 1 for every state and an out-of-bounds write at the last reachable state's slot. Fix: mask = bits strictly before low. The shift was self-consistent (values identical before/after — verified by re-running every measurement), the OOB was the defect.

red_then_green.test: t387_budget.test.T397 red-then-green: identityScan's bitpos loop returns (a u6 counter would wrap) — runs the PRODUCTION sampling loop (identityScan, factored out of valueModeImpl) over a two-word all-ones bitset with a bounded iteration counter; a regression FAILS loudly (checked != 128) instead of hanging the suite.
red_then_green.red: with bitpos: u6 planted: FAIL (TestUnexpectedResult), suite completes (no hang)
red_then_green.green: with bitpos: u7: All 78 tests passed (zig test -O ReleaseFast src/t387_budget.zig)

defect_class_sweep.found: one instance of the class (the u6 bitpos, fixed); all other loop counters are usize/u64/u7 or iterate ranges 0..n — none found beyond the fixed one

3x3_base_control.note: > 0 = the seeded control fires; the Orchestrator-saved 135,494 was the single-root DFS, the re-run uses the both-roots convention matching the t386 census

identity_reading.question: the minimax-identity (Bellman consistency) of the budget-in-the-key construction at 3x3 and 4x3 — the reading T387 was dispatched for
identity_reading.method: identityScan: for sampled non-terminal reachable states, recompute value from children's stored values and compare; density 1-in-100; denominators = states actually checked
identity_reading.verdict: 0 mismatches at both sizes with denominators up to 793,619 — the budget-in-the-key construction is Bellman-consistent. The operator's design stands: the counter belongs in the state key; no extra table growth beyond the (B+1) multiplier. Comparison class: T386 measured the PSK-pinning drift at 80/2,748 (3x3) and 496/51,318 (4x3); this construction pins nothing (single-pass DAG minimax) so the at-risk class is empty by construction and the sample confirms it.
identity_reading.scale_point: 3x3 budgeted graph = 423,922 states; a value pass over it is seconds. Any future run exceeding ~1 minute at 3x3 is hung (watchdog from the T397 brief).
